		dap_consider_building_effect = { BUILDING = workshops_04 FROM = workshops_03 COST = expensive_building_tier_4_cost INCOME_HOLDING = 0.200 INCOME_HOLDER = 0.000 INCOME_COUNTY = 0.000 DEVELOPMENT_COUNTY = 0.000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dap_can_build_workshops_05_trigger = yes }
		# next level: workshops_06; construction time: slow_construction_time
		dap_consider_building_effect = { BUILDING = workshops_05 FROM = workshops_04 COST = expensive_building_tier_5_cost INCOME_HOLDING = 0.200 INCOME_HOLDER = 0.000 INCOME_COUNTY = 0.000 DEVELOPMENT_COUNTY = 0.000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dap_can_build_workshops_06_trigger = yes }
		# next level: workshops_07; construction time: slow_construction_time
		dap_consider_building_effect = { BUILDING = workshops_06 FROM = workshops_05 COST = expensive_building_tier_6_cost INCOME_HOLDING = 0.200 INCOME_HOLDER = 0.000 INCOME_COUNTY = 0.000 DEVELOPMENT_COUNTY = 0.000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dap_can_build_workshops_07_trigger = yes }
		# next level: workshops_08; construction time: slow_construction_time
		dap_consider_building_effect = { BUILDING = workshops_07 FROM = workshops_06 COST = expensive_building_tier_7_cost INCOME_HOLDING = 0.200 INCOME_HOLDER = 0.000 INCOME_COUNTY = 0.000 DEVELOPMENT_COUNTY = 0.000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { dap_can_build_workshops_08_trigger = yes }
		# next level: none; construction time: slow_construction_time
		dap_consider_building_effect = { BUILDING = workshops_08 FROM = workshops_07 COST = expensive_building_tier_8_cost INCOME_HOLDING = 0.200 INCOME_HOLDER = 0.000 INCOME_COUNTY = 0.000 DEVELOPMENT_COUNTY = 0.000 }
	}
}
